Write, list and remove tables

Source: R/write.R
zuslothdb_tables.Rd

DBI::dbWriteTable() creates a table from a data frame, or replaces one (overwrite = TRUE) or adds to one (append = TRUE); DBI::dbAppendTable() adds the rows of a data frame to a table that exists. Columns are written as these SQL types, which DBI::dbDataType() reports:

Usage

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbWriteTable(
  conn,
  name,
  value,
  ...,
  row.names = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  append = FALSE,
  field.types = NULL,
  temporary = FALSE
)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,Id'
dbWriteTable(
  conn,
  name,
  value,
  ...,
  row.names = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  append = FALSE,
  field.types = NULL,
  temporary = FALSE
)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,SQL'
dbWriteTable(
  conn,
  name,
  value,
  ...,
  row.names = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  append = FALSE,
  field.types = NULL,
  temporary = FALSE
)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbAppendTable(conn, name, value, ..., row.names = NULL)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,Id'
dbAppendTable(conn, name, value, ..., row.names = NULL)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,SQL'
dbAppendTable(conn, name, value, ..., row.names = NULL)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection'
dbListTables(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbExistsTable(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,Id'
dbExistsTable(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,SQL'
dbExistsTable(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbListFields(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,Id'
dbListFields(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,SQL'
dbListFields(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbRemoveTable(conn, name, ..., temporary = FALSE, fail_if_missing = TRUE)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,Id'
dbRemoveTable(conn, name, ..., temporary = FALSE, fail_if_missing = TRUE)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,SQL'
dbRemoveTable(conn, name, ..., temporary = FALSE, fail_if_missing = TRUE)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbQuoteIdentifier(conn, x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection'
dbDataType(dbObj, obj, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_driver'
dbDataType(dbObj, obj, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection'
dbBegin(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection'
dbCommit(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection'
dbRollback(conn, ...)

Arguments

conn

A zuslothdb_connection.

name

The table's name: a string, DBI::Id() with only a table, or DBI::SQL() of a quoted name. Names are case-sensitive. SlothDB's parser cannot read a name holding ", so such a name is an error.

value

A data frame.

...

Not used.

row.names

As in DBI::sqlRownamesToColumn(): FALSE (the default) drops them, TRUE or a string writes them as a column.

overwrite, append

TRUE to replace or to add to a table that exists; at most one of them.

field.types

A named character vector of SQL types for some or all columns, in place of DBI::dbDataType()'s.

temporary

Not supported: SlothDB has no temporary tables.

fail_if_missing

For dbRemoveTable(): FALSE to do nothing when the table does not exist.

x

A character vector of identifiers.

dbObj

A zuslothdb_driver or zuslothdb_connection.

obj

A vector, or a data frame for the type of each column.

Value

dbWriteTable(), dbRemoveTable(): TRUE, invisibly. dbAppendTable(): the number of rows written. dbListTables(), dbListFields(): a character vector. dbExistsTable(): TRUE or FALSE. dbDataType(): a character vector. dbQuoteIdentifier(): DBI::SQL().

Details

RSlothDB
logicalBOOLEAN
integerINTEGER
doubleDOUBLE
character, factorVARCHAR
DateDATE
POSIXctTIMESTAMP, the instant in UTC, to the microsecond
bit64::integer64BIGINT
blob::blob(), or a list of raw vectorsBLOB

A column of another class, a value that does not fit its column (a fraction for an INTEGER, a number out of range, a string that is not valid UTF-8) or a column the table does not have is an error, raised before any row is written: the table is as it was. NA is written as NULL; NaN stays NaN.

SlothDB has no transactions: DBI::dbBegin(), DBI::dbCommit() and DBI::dbRollback() are zuslothdb_unsupported errors, and SQL ROLLBACK is an error saying that nothing was undone.

Examples

con <- DBI::dbConnect(zuslothdb())
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "cars", head(mtcars))
DBI::dbListTables(con)
#> [1] "cars"
DBI::dbReadTable(con, "cars")
#>    mpg cyl disp  hp drat    wt  qsec vs am gear carb
#> 1 21.0   6  160 110 3.90 2.620 16.46  0  1    4    4
#> 2 21.0   6  160 110 3.90 2.875 17.02  0  1    4    4
#> 3 22.8   4  108  93 3.85 2.320 18.61  1  1    4    1
#> 4 21.4   6  258 110 3.08 3.215 19.44  1  0    3    1
#> 5 18.7   8  360 175 3.15 3.440 17.02  0  0    3    2
#> 6 18.1   6  225 105 2.76 3.460 20.22  1  0    3    1
DBI::dbAppendTable(con, "cars", tail(mtcars))
#> [1] 6
DBI::dbRemoveTable(con, "cars")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
